name: rush_hour_benchmark_full_300
description: Benchmark of 300 Rush Hour puzzle instances intended to evaluate planning and reinforcement-learning agents on puzzle-solving performance; it measures agents' ability to find solutions and the efficiency of those solutions across instances. The benchmark provides standardized episodes and metrics to compare learning and planning approaches on a diverse set of puzzle configurations.
reputation: Relatively niche benchmark used within the MultiRL community and by researchers studying planning/SLG-style puzzles.
